receipts.detail: buildImage records the id the tag named before the build (imageIdOf) and, after a successful build, retirePreviousImage removes it when untagged and unused, without force; red before the fix (6 of 7 tests), green after

kept-tagged (another tag names it), kept-in-use (a container, running or stopped, uses it), kept-remove-failed (the daemon refuses, e.g. dependent child images), kept-unverified (a step cannot be read), none (no previous image, the same image, already gone); another dangling image is never touched and there is no prune; a failed build retires nothing; mutations of the tagged, in-use, same-image and removal-error guards each turn their test red

operation events image.retire-previous with stage recorded (previousId, before the build) and the outcome stage (previousId, currentId, detail) after it, through the provider's operation sink (the run's docker operation log); asserted in every test
